summary: Warehouse associate with a year in an export processing zone warehouse on Mactan. I receive, store, pick and count stock, operate a forklift safely, and check every delivery against its paperwork before it goes into the system. I want to become an inventory controller.

Operate a reach forklift and follow the site's stacking height and aisle rules.
